name: 98057 · Renton, WA
findings: ZIP 98057 (Renton) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 96 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98057 (Renton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98057 (Renton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.9 times the typical level).
